blocks.text: Yeh samajhne ke liye ke energy waves ki shakal mein kaise phailti hai, hamein wavefront ka tasawwur (concept) samajhna hoga. Wavefront aik khayali (imaginary) satah hai jo un tamam points ko jorti hai jahan waves ka phase aik jaisa ho.
Wavefronts teen qism ke hote hain:

items: Plane wavefronts: seedhi lakeeron ki tarah dikhaye jate hain, jaise door ke sitaron se aane wali roshni ki lehrein aur ripple tank mein pani ki lehrein.
Circular wavefronts: dairon (circles) ki tarah dikhaye jate hain, jaise talab ke pani mein bante hain.
Spherical wavefronts: teen dimensions wali space mein awaz ya roshni ki wave se bante hain (gend ki satah jaise).

blocks.text: Space mein point source ke wavefronts hamesha spherical hote hain, yani har simt phailte hain. Bohat zyada faasle par, jaise Sooraj se aane wali roshni, yeh wavefronts zameen ki satah par plane (seedhe) maane ja sakte hain. Do lagatar wavefronts ka sab se chhota faasla hamesha wave ki wavelength ke barabar hota hai. Wave ki energy hamesha wavefront ki satah ke har point par perpendicular (amood, 90°) simt mein jati hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. (a) Saat mutawazi khari lakeerein (plane wavefronts) jinhein aik ufqi teer (ray) amudan kaat-ta hai. (b) Surkh point source ke gird hum-markaz daire, aur aath teer bahar ki taraf. (c) Point source se daen khulta cone; cone mein teen kham-daar tukre jo faasle ke saath bare hote hain, har aik par bahar ki taraf teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.1: (a, b, c) Plane aur circular lehrein; spherical wavefronts ke hisse. Source se bohat door har hissa plane ban jata hai (kitab ki Figure 15.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig 15.1 (b) par 'Gas pressure' aur 'Self-gravity' likha hai; yeh labels chapter 13 ki kisi aur figure se ghalti se aa gaye hain aur wavefronts se in ka koi talluq nahi, is liye khaake mein nahi. Har ray (shua) wavefront par amood (perpendicular) hoti hai, aur source se door spherical wavefront ka chhota hissa taqreeban seedha (plane) lagta hai.

Agar source periodic ho (baar baar aik jaisa jhoole) to woh aik hi shakal ke wavefronts ka silsila banata hai. Plane wavefronts plane source se, ya bohat door ke kisi bhi source se bante hain. Line source, maslan ripple tank ka vibrator, do dimensions mein seedhe (plane) wavefronts banata hai. Point source S do dimensions mein circular aur teen dimensions mein spherical wavefronts banata hai (Fig. 15.1). Wavefront par perpendicular woh lakeer jo wave ke chalne ki simt dikhaye, ray (shua) kehlati hai (Fig. 15.1 (a)).

Is chapter mein hum interference aur diffraction parhne ke liye mukhtalif sources se plane wavefronts farz karenge. Agar roshni ka source lens ke focal point par rakha jaye to lens ki doosri taraf plane wavefronts bante hain.

blocks.prompt: Ray aur wavefront ka kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Ray wavefront par perpendicular lakeer hai jo dikhati hai ke wave (aur us ki energy) kis simt ja rahi hai.

items: Wavefront: barabar phase wale points ko jorne wali khayali satah.
Plane, circular aur spherical wavefronts; bohat door spherical wavefront plane lagta hai.
Wavefronts ka faasla = aik wavelength; ray wavefront par perpendicular hoti hai.
Lens ke focal point par source rakhne se plane wavefronts milte hain.
